answer: The defence rests on mountain rescue team membership with callout history: callouts answered with one team for years. Forging 532 of these means building 532 separate callout histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The bridge check runs in the open: 532 fakes pay the full price 532 times, one honest agent pays once, and the pearl trail in the ledger makes the nebula cost visible to everyone.
